metadata.description: Replay Doctor for Claude Code: names the turn your prompt cache broke on and what it cost, from the transcripts already on your disk. Prints one line at the end of each session; sends nothing unless you configure a repository to watch.

plugins.name: replay
plugins.description: Prompt-cache forensics at the end of every session. Local only; the binary cannot send. Optional: post a counts-only record per session to a repository you named on replay.doctor.
